purpose: Declare, before any budget-point replay result is inspected, how the training-amount experiment is read: the undertrained-versus-saturated decision table, its thresholds, the mandatory three-state verdict and the probe that follows an inconclusive reading. This is a screening rule for choosing the next experiment. It can never promote anything.
question: At the frozen MLPLOB v3 60-day CSZ recipe, does raising the optimizer budget from 1.32 to 2.64 and 5.28 effective epochs keep improving the competition metrics, or is the recipe already saturated?
single_factor: optimizer budget only: trunk, data, labels, loss, sampling, learning-rate rule and evaluation stay frozen to configs/mlplob_v3_60d_csz_19800.json

arms.label: anchor-1.32
arms.note: the existing 19,800-step checkpoint (1.3215 realised); reused, never retrained for this comparison

primary_pair.why: the floor is applied to the last doubling so that an early gain between 1.32 and 2.64 cannot hide a plateau between 2.64 and 5.28; the anchor-to-each comparisons are reported as context only

windows.caliber: the five already-viewed development months used by the registered threshold basis; the same window definition and targets_sha256 as runs/b4-volatility-20261027/20261027T064907Z_a79926d3e455/volatility.json

interval.method: moving consecutive trading-day blocks inside each declared period; blocks never cross a period gap
interval.seed_slots: never fabricated: the arms are deterministic aggregates

estimator.cost_scenarios: 0/2/5/10bp remain reported as economics; 5bp stays the locked stress scenario and is never a substitute for the primary metric

improvement_floor.definition: min_improvement / 2, rounded up on the registered primary grid
improvement_floor.why_half: the rule asks whether a further doubling still moves the primary metric by at least half the promotion floor. Requiring the full 0.0034 for every doubling would make 'keep training' unreachable by construction; requiring less than half would read measured noise as a trend.
improvement_floor.does_not_replace: min_improvement 0.0034 stays the only promotion threshold

saturation_band.why: a point estimate at or below zero whose interval covers zero is the only reading that supports 'no further gain' without overclaiming

loss_trend.metric: mean training loss per effective epoch at each budget point, as recorded by the trajectory
loss_trend.undetermined: anything else, including a missing or unreconciled loss record
loss_trend.epistemics: declared before any rollout loss was inspected. Unlike min_improvement this is not a measured scale: it is the operationalisation of 'falling' versus 'flat' announced in advance so the table cannot be read after the fact.

still_improving: at least 4 of the 5 declared periods show a positive paired effect
inconclusive: every other reading, including a positive improvement whose interval covers zero, fewer than 4 positive periods, or an arm that could not be evaluated

prohibited_claims: claiming 'undertrained' or 'saturated' from training loss alone
claiming either side while the verdict is inconclusive
lowering the 0.0017 floor or the 4-of-5 repeat rule after seeing results
relaxing the 5bp stress scenario or reading a cost scenario as a primary-metric result
substituting an in-arm percentile for the official turnover item
using this rule to promote, freeze or submit anything: promotion stays with scripts/promotion_gate.py under min_improvement 0.0034

decision_table.applies_only_when: the loss trend is determined (falling or plateaued) AND the validation verdict is determined (still_improving or saturated); every other combination resolves to the inconclusive state

cells.next_step_detail: add one further budget point by doubling again, with the same recipe and the same evaluation caliber

cells.conclusion_label: 过拟合 60 日样本（数据受限）
cells.next_step_detail: do not add epochs: the loss is still falling while out-of-sample ranking has stopped improving

cells.conclusion_label: 优化收敛（容量/结构受限）
cells.next_step: widen the model or change the structure
cells.next_step_detail: the budget is not the binding constraint; capacity or inductive bias is

unregistered_combination.why: no cell of the declared 2 x 2 covers a flat loss with a still-improving validation metric; inventing one after the fact would be reading the result backwards
unregistered_combination.first_action: audit the loss accounting (per-epoch mean exposure and the reconciled exposure report) before drawing any conclusion, then re-read under this same table

probe_routing.rule: when the verdict is inconclusive the preregistration names the next probe; exactly one probe per round, and each probe must be pre-registered on its own before it runs and is read under this same three-state rule

upper_bound.what: training-set own IC at 5.28 effective epochs
upper_bound.answers: can the recipe fit the training distribution at all, or is optimization/capacity the binding constraint
upper_bound.question: 训练集自身 IC 上限

data.what: 5.28 effective epochs with the 132-day window instead of 60-day
data.answers: is the 60-day sample the binding constraint
data.question: 5.28 步数换 132 日

capacity.what: 1.32 effective epochs with the trunk widened 1.5-2x
capacity.answers: is model capacity the binding constraint at the current budget
capacity.question: 1.32 epoch 加宽 1.5-2 倍

routes.when: verdict inconclusive and loss trend falling
routes.then: data only if the training-set IC shows the model can fit
routes.why: a falling loss with an unclear out-of-sample reading is a generalization question first; the training-set IC separates 'cannot fit' from 'fits but does not generalize' before any new data window is spent

routes.when: verdict inconclusive and loss trend plateaued
routes.then: structure change if widening 1.5-2x at the anchor budget does not move the primary metric
routes.why: a flat loss at a flat out-of-sample reading points at capacity, and the cheap test is widening at the cheapest budget

routes.detail: repair the loss/exposure accounting first; no probe is licensed from an unread loss trend

relation_to_registered_gate.note: this document adds a screening rule and changes no promotion threshold, no secondary line, no net5 limit, no resource budget, no evidence rule and no period declaration of the registered b4 gate
a_candidate_that_clears_this_rule_still_: a paired improvement of at least min_improvement 0.0034 against the registered baseline
no secondary regression beyond its measured limit
no net5 regression beyond its measured limit
resource compliance on the inference/submission path
multi-seed aggregation: a single-seed arm cannot clear the ic_mean secondary line on noise alone

notes: the 1.32 anchor is the existing 19,800-step checkpoint, so only the two new budget points are new evaluations
every number here was fixed before any budget-point replay metric was read; the registration record carries the timestamp and the hash of this file
the loss trend epsilon is a pre-declared operationalisation, not a measured threshold; it cannot be tuned after the fact
if the result later contradicts the table, the table is not relaxed: the honest outcome is the three-state 'evidence insufficient' plus the named probe
